requirement: Controlled policy import creates policy + expected receipts + portfolio, never confirmed cobro without evidence.

behavior: applyImport inserts/updates the polizas collection directly through Orbit.store.
polizas.afterInsert generates installment rows directly in cobros with estado=Pendiente and conciliado=false.
The import path does not call Orbit.policyReceipts.createPolicy/updatePolicy.
The direct Orbit.store insert/update path is optimistic and starts individual server calls without awaiting an atomic business transaction.
createPolicy/updatePolicy build one atomic mutation plan.
The atomic plan writes polizas + recibosEsperados + carteraPrimas + activity.
The canonical plan does not create cobros; payment evidence remains a separate domain.
batchDurable requires canonical server readback for the complete mutation set.

impact: A policy imported through the legacy route can persist independently from its expected receipt/portfolio schedule and can create legacy cobros rows that are not payment evidence. This violates the canonical domain boundary and durable all-or-nothing contract.

requirements: Await durable completion before reporting success or closing the importer.
Remove policy-import creation of legacy cobros rows.
Policy import scope declares polizas + recibosEsperados + carteraPrimas and explicitly excludes cobros.
Normalize importer field aliases to the canonical policy contract.
Fail closed when the canonical owner is unavailable or rejects a row.

proofRequired: Source contract proves no policy import afterInsert writes cobros.
Controlled valid synthetic import creates one policy and the expected recibosEsperados + carteraPrimas.
Controlled import creates zero cobros for that policy.
All created rows share the same policy relation and authoritative tenant scope.
Invalid/ambiguous controlled case fails closed without confirmed payment creation.
Cleanup returns synthetic residue to zero.
